proof_body:
by
  intro G _ N _
  have hsurj := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N
  constructor
  · intro hS
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (inferInstance : Nontrivial (G ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup G)))
      induction a using QuotientGroup.induction_on
      induction b using QuotientGroup.induction_on
      exact hab ((QuotientGroup.eq).2 trivial)
    · intro K hK hNK
      haveI := hK
      rcases (Subgroup.Normal.map hK (QuotientGroup.mk' N) hsurj).eq_bot_or_eq_top with h | h
      · left
        apply le_antisymm _ hNK
        intro x hx
        have : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) x ∈ K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [h, Subgroup.mem_bot] at this
        exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff x).1 this
      · right
        rw [eq_top_iff]
        intro x _
        have hx : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) x ∈ K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by rw [h]; trivial
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx
        have h2 : y⁻¹ * x ∈ N := (QuotientGroup.eq).1 hxy
        have h3 : x = y * (y⁻¹ * x) := by group
        rw [h3]
        exact K.mul_mem hy (hNK h2)
  · rintro ⟨hne, hmax⟩
    have hnt : Nontrivial (G ⧸ N) := by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g, g ∉ N := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        exact hne (eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => hc x)
      exact ⟨⟨(g : G ⧸ N), 1, fun h => hg ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).1 h)⟩⟩
    refine ⟨fun L hL => ?_⟩
    have hle : N ≤ L.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Subgroup.mem_comap]
      have : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) x = 1 := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff x).2 hx
      rw [this]
      exact L.one_mem
    rcases hmax _ (hL.comap _) hle with h | h
    · left
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj q
      have : y ∈ N := by rw [← h]; exact hq
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff y).2 this
    · right
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro q _
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj q
      have : y ∈ L.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by rw [h]; trivial
      exact this
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], IsSimpleGroup (G ⧸ N) ↔ N ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal → N ≤ K → K = N ∨ K = ⊤
